{{E|The Colosseum}} is an [[Event]] found exclusively in [[Act 2]]. It only appears after the guaranteed [[Map Locations#Treasure Room|Treasure Room]] on the 6th floor.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Fight}}
* The player enters a fight with a {{M|Blue Slaver}} and {{M|Red Slaver}}. This fight gives no rewards.
<blockquote>
After the fight ends, a choice has to be made: 

{{Frame|COWARDICE}} Escape.
<br>
<br>
{{Frame|VICTORY}} A powerful fight with many rewards.
* The player enters a fight with {{M|Taskmaster}} and {{M|Gremlin Nob}}.
* The rewards are 100 [[Gold]], 1 {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Rare|Rare}} [[Relic]], 1 {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Uncommon|Uncommon}} [[Relic]], a card reward, and sometimes a [[Potion]].
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
Some mechanics behave strangely during the two fights in this event due to their atypical nature:
* {{Frame|Fight}} is treated as a normal combat.
** {{P|Smoke Bomb}} can be used to escape the fight and the player will still be prompted to choose either {{Frame|COWARDICE}} or {{Frame|VICTORY}} afterwards as normal.
** The game still rolls to drop a [[Potion]], but never presents the player with it even if a [[Potion]] would be dropped. This means it is impossible to know if the [[Potions#Sources|potion chance]] has increased or decreased, and this uncertainty will persist until the [[Potions#Sources|potion chance]] resets at start of the next act.
** While it has no combat rewards and transitions to the next dialogue of the event very quickly, end-of-combat effects like {{R|Burning Blood}} and {{C|Self Repair}} will still trigger.
* {{Frame|VICTORY}} is treated as an [[Elite]] combat for ''most'' effects.
** {{R|Preserved Insect}}, {{R|Sling of Courage}}, and {{R|Slaver's Collar}} will all trigger their effects as expected.
** The only exception is {{R|Black Star}}, which has no effect on the [[Relics]] dropped as rewards. This combat will ''always'' drop exactly 1 {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Rare|Rare}} [[Relic]] and 1 {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Uncommon|Uncommon}} [[Relic]].

== Trivia ==
* The "armored giant with a {{TS|gold||golden crown}}" is likely {{M|The Champ}}.

== Update History ==
* '''Patch V1.1: The Dealer'''
** Colosseum event now appears only at the top half of Act 2.
* '''Slay the Spire 1.0: Farewell Early Access'''
** Colossuem Nob fight ordering swapped so that the Nob can apply Vulnerable.
* '''Weekly Patch 56: The Collector'''
** Colosseum event's second fight is now a Gremlin Nob + Taskmaster (rather than 2 Gremlin Nobs)
* '''Weekly Patch 42: Reboot'''
** Orb VFX no longer render in the background of the Colosseum event.
* '''Weekly Patch 41: Chill'''
** Colosseum Nobs no longer play double music.
** Fixed bug causing block to maintain between colosseum combats.
** Fixed Smoke Bomb and Colosseum bug that caused the player to go invisible.
** Killing a Colosseum Nob no longer causes the music to stop.
* '''Weekly Patch 39: We Meet Again!'''
** Added City Event: The Colosseum.
